summary.text: Erik Severson is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Charly Ray for a seat with no incumbent.
A physician, he previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 28 from 2011 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Erik Severson earned a B.S. from the University of Minnesota, Duluth, in 1993 and an M.D. from the Mayo Medical School in 2002.

He completed a medical internship at the University of North Dakota and a family medicine residency at the University of Minnesota, and worked as an emergency room physician in Osceola before his election.
Severson assumed office in the Wisconsin State Assembly in 2011 and left in 2015.
In the 2011-2012 session he served on the Energy and Utilities, Health (as vice chair) and Natural Resources committees, and in 2013 he chaired the Health and Mental Health committees.
He defeated Angie Sapik in the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 25 on August 11, 2026.
